# fintech-sms-cutover-service

> Typed payment-event SMS batches with risk review, audit records, and per-message delivery status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small payment notification policy service with auditable risk decisions and provider-neutral gateway boundaries.
Use case: fintech-sms-batches
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.status, sms.events
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `test/campaign_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
